rationale: Edge-case lens ran; no spec/story existed (no-spec round, confidence low). One patch finding: test asserts scrollbar-gutter-edge but omits the show-scroll class introduced by this fix — if removed, no test fails. One finding deferred: Safari scrollbar-gutter fallback gap at ChatHistory.tsx:53 is pre-existing (see code-review-deferred.md).

findings.title: Missing show-scroll assertion in scrollbar test
findings.problem: The test added for this change asserts that scrollbar-gutter-edge is present and scrollbar-gutter is absent, but does not assert that show-scroll is present. Removing show-scroll from ChatHistory.tsx would not cause any test to fail.
findings.impact: The core behavioral change — scrollbar visibility controlled by show-scroll — has no automated guard. The fix can silently regress in any future className edit to the scroll container.
findings.recommendation: Add expect(scrollDiv.classList.contains('show-scroll')).toBe(true) to the existing test case alongside the scrollbar-gutter-edge assertion.
